intro: The Reel canister keeps your essentials fresh and organised. With an air-proof seal, strong polystyrene build, and a practical set of three, it’s made for kitchens where every detail matters.

features.title: Built to last with durable polystyrene
features.text: Made from high-quality polystyrene, our design is sturdy, reliable, and ready for everyday use—keeping your kitchen essentials safe.

features.title: Air-proof lid to lock in freshness
features.text: Designed to keep moisture out and flavour in, our secure seal ensures ingredients stay fresh and protected for longer.

features.title: A set of three for easy organisation
features.text: Our thoughtfully designed set helps you neatly store pantry staples, keeping your kitchen tidy, clutter-free, and effortlessly organised.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Reel Canister
